title: 窦娥冤（滚绣球）
titleEn: The Injustice to Dou E (aria “Rolling Embroidered Ball”)
author: 关汉卿
intro: A young widow, falsely accused of murder, is led to her execution — and on the way she curses Heaven and Earth for failing to tell good from evil. The most famous cry of protest in Chinese drama.
analysis: 《窦娥冤》是元代最有名的悲剧。窦娥是一个善良的年轻寡妇，被坏人张驴儿诬陷杀人，贪官严刑逼供，判她死刑。这段唱词是第三折里窦娥被押去刑场的路上唱的。古人相信天地日月和鬼神主持公道，好人有好报，坏人有恶报。可窦娥看到的却相反：做好事的人又穷又短命，做坏事的人又富又长寿；盗跖是古代有名的大盗，颜渊是孔子最好的学生，天地却把他们弄颠倒了。她骂天地“怕硬欺软”“顺水推船”，最后喊出：“地也，你不分好歹何为地！天也，你错勘贤愚枉做天！”在古代，天地是最神圣的，敢这样指责天地，说明窦娥的冤屈已经到了极点。这段唱词用的是元代口语，排比句（结构相同的句子连在一起）一句比一句激烈，读起来很有力量。“六月飞雪”“感天动地”这些说法，也都来自这部戏。
analysisEn: The Injustice to Dou E is the most famous tragedy of the Yuan dynasty. Dou E is a kind young widow. A villain falsely accuses her of murder, and a corrupt judge tortures her into a confession and sentences her to death. She sings this aria in Act Three, on the way to the execution ground. People then believed that Heaven and Earth, the sun, the moon and the spirits kept the world fair: good people are rewarded, bad people punished. Dou E sees the opposite. Those who do good are poor and die young; those who do evil grow rich and live long. Heaven and Earth have mixed up Robber Zhi, a legendary bandit, with Yan Yuan, Confucius’s most virtuous student. She accuses them of bullying the weak and fearing the strong, of simply pushing the boat the way the current flows. Then she cries out: “Earth, if you can’t tell good from bad, what makes you Earth? Heaven, if you mistake the wise for the foolish, you are Heaven in name only!” Heaven and Earth were the most sacred things in old China, so blaming them shows how complete her despair is. The aria is in the spoken Chinese of the time, and its parallel lines — sentences built the same way, one after another — grow fiercer as they go. Sayings like “snow in June” for a terrible injustice come from this play.
background: Guan Hanqing (c. 1220s–c. 1300) was the leading playwright of Yuan zaju drama, credited with more than sixty plays. Under Mongol rule many educated Chinese were shut out of official careers, and drama like his often speaks for ordinary people against corrupt power.
pronunciation: 朝暮 zhāo mù（早晚，不读 cháo）；掌着 zhe；只合 zhǐ hé（只应该）；清浊 zhuó；盗跖 zhí；为善的、何为地的“为”读 wéi（做；作为）；错勘 kān；只落得 luò de；哎 āi。“做得个”的“个”按本调标 gè，口语可读轻声。
version: 采用统编语文教材必修下册文本。节选自杂剧《感天动地窦娥冤》第三折中的一支曲子【正宫·滚绣球】，全曲十一句，此处完整收录这一支（全剧共四折一楔子）。异文：明代刊本作“却元来也这般顺水推船”，教材作“却原来”；“何为地”句末明刊本用句号，教材用感叹号。

lines.py: yǒu rì yuè zhāo mù xuán
lines.lit: There are the sun and moon, hanging morning and evening;
lines.en: The sun and the moon hang in the sky morning and night,

lines.py: yǒu guǐ shén zhǎng zhe shēng sǐ quán
lines.lit: there are ghosts and gods holding the power of life and death.
lines.en: and the spirits hold the power of life and death.

lines.zh: 天地也只合把清浊分辨，
lines.rhythm: 天地也/只合把/清浊/分辨
lines.py: tiān dì yě zhǐ hé bǎ qīng zhuó fēn biàn
lines.lit: Heaven and Earth ought only to tell the clear from the muddy,
lines.en: Heaven and Earth, your one task is to tell the clean from the foul —

lines.zh: 可怎生糊突了盗跖、颜渊？
lines.rhythm: 可怎生/糊突了/盗跖、颜渊
lines.py: kě zěn shēng hú tū le dào zhí yán yuān
lines.lit: but how did you muddle up Robber Zhi and Yan Yuan?
lines.en: so how could you mix up a robber with a saint?

lines.py: wéi shàn de shòu pín qióng gèng mìng duǎn
lines.lit: Those who do good suffer poverty and, more, short lives;
lines.en: Those who do good stay poor and die young;

lines.py: zào è de xiǎng fù guì yòu shòu yán
lines.lit: those who do evil enjoy wealth and rank and long lives too.
lines.en: those who do evil grow rich and live long.

lines.zh: 天地也，做得个怕硬欺软，
lines.rhythm: 天地也，做得个/怕硬/欺软
lines.py: tiān dì yě, zuò de gè pà yìng qī ruǎn
lines.lit: Heaven and Earth, you act as one who fears the hard and bullies the soft;
lines.en: Heaven and Earth, you fear the strong and bully the weak —

lines.zh: 却原来也这般顺水推船！
lines.rhythm: 却原来/也这般/顺水/推船
lines.py: què yuán lái yě zhè bān shùn shuǐ tuī chuán
lines.lit: so it turns out you too just push the boat along with the current!
lines.en: so you too just drift along with whoever is winning!

lines.zh: 地也，你不分好歹何为地！
lines.rhythm: 地也，你不分/好歹/何为地
lines.py: dì yě, nǐ bù fēn hǎo dǎi hé wéi dì
lines.lit: Earth, you don’t tell good from bad — how can you be Earth!
lines.en: Earth! If you can’t tell good from bad, what right have you to be Earth?
lines.tts: 地也，你不分好歹何维地！

lines.zh: 天也，你错勘贤愚枉做天！
lines.rhythm: 天也，你错勘/贤愚/枉做天
lines.py: tiān yě, nǐ cuò kān xián yú wǎng zuò tiān
lines.lit: Heaven, you misjudge the wise and the foolish — you are Heaven in vain!
lines.en: Heaven! You mistake the good for the wicked — you are Heaven in name only!

lines.py: āi, zhǐ luò de liǎng lèi lián lián
lines.lit: Ah, all I am left with is two streams of flowing tears.
lines.en: Ah — nothing is left to me but my endless tears.

words.note: 朝：早晨。今天还有成语“朝三暮四”。

words.en: to hold; to be in charge of

words.note: 合：应该。元代口语，今天不用。

words.en: clear and muddy — i.e. good and bad
words.note: 比喻好人和坏人、是和非。
元代口语，相当于“怎么”“怎样”。
古代传说中的大盗，代表坏人。
孔子最欣赏的学生，品德好却贫穷早死，代表好人。

words.en: to fear the strong and bully the weak
to push the boat with the current; to go along with whoever is powerful
words.note: 今天也说“顺水推舟”，意思稍有不同（顺着情势方便行事）。
今天仍用，如“不知好歹”；也表示“无论如何”。
贤：有德有才，如“贤人”；愚：笨，如“愚蠢”。
现代汉语有“枉费心机”“冤枉”。
形容泪流不止。今天书面语还说“泪涟涟”。

imagery.name: 天地
imagery.zh: 古人心中最公正、最神圣的天地，在窦娥眼里却是非不分、欺软怕硬，指责天地写出她冤屈之深。
imagery.en: Heaven and Earth, the highest guardians of justice, have failed her; daring to curse them shows how deep her injustice runs.

imagery.name: 日月
imagery.zh: 日月高悬，本应照见人间善恶，却照不出窦娥的冤情。
imagery.en: The sun and moon hang overhead and should see everything — yet they do not see the wrong done to her.

imagery.name: 泪
imagery.zh: 骂完天地，窦娥还是无能为力，只剩下流不完的眼泪。
imagery.en: After all her fury, she is still powerless; only endless tears remain.
